categories.main_business_segments: Weima Agricultural Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the specialized equipment manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, design, production, and sales of mountain and hilly agricultural machinery and other power machinery products. Their product portfolio includes tillage machinery, field management machinery, harvesting machinery, irrigation and drainage machinery, internal combustion engines, snow sweepers, generator sets, and small construction machinery. The company also develops new energy electric agricultural machinery and related power equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies in power systems, transmission systems, and whole machine design, with proprietary production capabilities for key components such as electric motor assemblies, transmission housings, and drive assemblies. They employ advanced manufacturing methods including modular design, intelligent manufacturing, and integration of AI tools for product development. The company is advancing electric, lightweight, and unmanned agricultural machinery technologies, with ongoing R&D in intelligent control systems and unmanned driving for machinery like rotary tillers and harvesters.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Weima serves both domestic and international customers, including end-users in mountainous and hilly agricultural regions, municipal landscaping, orchards, nurseries, and construction sectors. Key international customers include leading global companies such as the forestry machinery leader Fushihua Group and the largest outdoor power equipment gasoline engine manufacturer, Briggs & Stratton. The company’s products are sold in over 70 countries and regions, with a focus on markets in Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and manufacturing bases in Chongqing and Wuxi, and has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and production facilities in Thailand, the United States, Europe, and Russia. Overseas sales account for approximately 85% of total revenue, with strategic focus on Southeast Asia, Latin America, North America, and Europe. The company is building localized service systems and diversified sales channels in these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Weima operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the agricultural machinery supply chain, encompassing R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales of finished machinery and power units. The company maintains vertical integration by producing key components internally, ensuring control over critical parts of the supply chain such as power systems and transmission assemblies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include leading with intelligent and globalized development, focusing on new energy power and smart agricultural machinery. Key R&D directions involve breakthroughs in electrification, lightweight design, and unmanned operation technologies. They emphasize modular product platforms tailored to diverse terrains and aim to transform from traditional equipment manufacturing to providing smart agricultural solutions integrating machinery, services, and data. Investments in intelligent flexible production bases and overseas manufacturing facilities support these goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of agricultural machinery and power equipment products, including both direct sales under the company’s own brand and ODM/OEM manufacturing for other brands. Sales channels include domestic and international direct sales and buyout distribution. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Weima is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer specializing in mountain and hilly agricultural machinery, with strong competitive advantages in technology, product quality, and manufacturing scale. It holds a significant market presence in China and has growing international recognition. The company competes in a fragmented market with increasing competition but differentiates itself through innovation, customization, and expanding global footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Weima reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 925 million, representing a 17.27% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 79.5 million, up 9.5%. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, with over 445,000 units of mountain and hilly agricultural machinery sold in 2024. Total assets reached RMB 1.4 billion, reflecting an 8.07% increase from the previous year. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Weima emphasizes delivering agricultural machinery tailored to the unique conditions of mountainous and hilly terrains, offering products that are flexible, lightweight, safe, and efficient. Their integration of internal combustion and new energy power systems provides complementary advantages. The company’s focus on intelligent, modular, and unmanned machinery solutions, combined with a comprehensive global service network, differentiates it as a provider of advanced, customized agricultural equipment designed to enhance productivity and sustainability in challenging agricultural environments.
